synopsis: Within a month or two of Silvermoon’s admission to the Horde and the first blood shed at Hillsbrad, the Burning Legion’s reopening of the Dark Portal turns political realignment into immediate war. Demons pouring through the gateway range beyond the Blasted Lands, striking settlements and supply routes hard enough that both Horde and Alliance must answer the threat. Falanaras marches with blood elf forces as part of the Horde response alongside Theron, Lethira, and the mixed Horde comrades who fought at Tarren Mill—Gorath Stonebinder, Jazreth Shadowtide, Mavren Coldwake, and Tahu Windtotem—while the sin’dorei find an uneasy foothold within their new faction. The Blood Knights stand openly as one of Quel’Thalas’s defining weapons. At the threshold, Falanaras sees how far his people have traveled since Kael’thas’s first summons: Rynel dead, M’uru chained, the prince disowned, old friendships broken, and Silvermoon’s future bound to allies who do not fully trust them. Falanaras steps through the Dark Portal carrying those costs into the next war.
title: Epilogue: Beyond the Dark Portal
